act.name: Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006
act.source_authority: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Government of India
act.description: Central law regulating food safety, food-business responsibilities, enforcement, unsafe food and penalties.

sections.title: Responsibilities of the food business operator.
sections.text: Section 26 concerns food-business-operator responsibility to ensure compliance and safe food; consult the linked official text for the complete provision.
sections.plain_language_summary: A food business operator must ensure that food under its control complies with the Act and applicable requirements.
